title: Why Lucas Digne is Not Playing for PSG Against Monaco
seoTitle: Why Lucas Digne is not playing for PSG against Monaco
subtitle: Understand Luis Enrique's decision and what it reveals about the French full-back's adaptation
excerpt: Lucas Digne, newly signed by PSG, was not included in the squad to face Monaco this Friday.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Lucas Digne, the newly arrived left-back at Paris Saint-Germain, has been left out of the squad to face Monaco this Friday at 9:05 PM at the Parc des Princes. The exclusion, announced on the morning of the match, raises questions about his adaptation and manager Luis Enrique's assessment.

What motivated Digne's omission

According to information from the club, the decision was made for "sporting" reasons. The Spanish manager had already opted for Warren Zaïre-Emery in the match against Lille, suggesting he does not yet fully trust the new signing's performance. A lack of physical fitness was also cited as a factor influencing the choice.

How the situation affects Digne's image at PSG

Digne arrived at PSG from Aston Villa for less than 10 million euros, with the expectation of being an immediate starter. In just a few weeks, he went from starting for the French national team in the World Cup semifinals to being a substitute at the club. This rapid shift raises questions about his level of commitment and the perception that he may be accepting a backup role behind Nuno Mendes.

Player's reaction and future expectations

In an interview, Digne stated he would not worry after just three matches, but the exclusion from the clash against Monaco could be a warning sign from Luis Enrique. The manager, who knew Digne at Barcelona, expects the full-back to raise the collective standard of demand. Digne's attitude in training and on days off at the Campus will be closely watched.

Impact on PSG's next big match

PSG has not yet won any of their opening matches of the Ligue 1 season, while Monaco has accumulated two victories. Digne's absence could influence the attacking and defensive dynamics of the Parisian team, which is looking to get back to winning ways in front of its home crowd.

Outlook for the 2026-2027 season

Digne's future at PSG will depend on his ability to improve his physical conditioning and meet Luis Enrique's tactical demands. If he can overcome his current athletic deficit, he could regain the manager's trust and compete for a regular spot in the starting lineup throughout the campaign.

With information from L'Équipe, OneFootball.
